title: Chicago BYOT Screen Printing Workshop: Make Your Own Art Tee
blurb:
Remade in Chicago is the upcycling studio where surplus textiles are transformed into one-of-a-kind wearable art, braided rugs, and hand-stitched quilts. 

We host public and private workshops, and we love to partner with DIY-enthusiasts on custom projects.

Our aim is to inspire folks to creatively modify their wardrobes, extend the life of cherished items, and be savvy textile consumers.
